CIV.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
The AI use named is a land-cover map for agriculture and forests, not general administration.

facts.fact: Abidjan.net reports that BNETD presented the 2020 land-cover map on 26 March 2024, with AI recognition of forests on 2020 Sentinel imagery, offered through an online platform as a monitoring tool for the national sustainable cocoa strategy, as stated by BNETD's digital director and ministry representatives.

CIV.note: The document states AI used to classify imagery but no AI model, dataset made for AI or AI computing developed or hosted in the country.
